exit.1: expectation not met (not verified, flaky, or verified inspection findings)
exit.4: inconclusive (inconclusive, or inspection blocked / unreachable / timeout)
exit.7: no browser could start on this computer (nothing was concluded about the target)
exit.8: cost limit: the model was not called, its estimate was over the limit

progress.waiting: Waiting for the CLI's first progress report…
progress.label: Pages of this run

access.opened: A browser window has been opened on this computer.
access.saved: The access was saved encrypted on this computer. The next inspections of this site will use it on their own.
access.notSaved: Nothing was saved: the block was still there at the end, or the window was closed too early. The detail is in the output.
access.step1: Go to the browser window that has just opened (it may be behind this one).
access.stepConsent: Choose in the cookie banner (the most private option works).
access.noTyping: EXEGEZIS does not type or read what you type.
access.step3: When you see the page you wanted, come back here and press “Done” (or close the window).

search.title: Search
search.heading: Search {what}
search.queued: Another inspection or search is running; this one starts as soon as it ends.
search.running: The CLI is reading the site. This page follows its progress.
search.lost: The process is gone and never reported its exit (the UI server was probably restarted).
search.noReport: The CLI finished without a report: the detail is in the output.
search.summary: {hits, plural, one {# result} other {# results}} · {searched} of {found} pages searched.
search.noBrowser: No browser could start (exit code 7): nothing was searched on the site.

inspect.title: Inspection
inspect.queued: Another inspection is running; this one starts as soon as it ends.
inspect.running: The CLI is inspecting the site. This page follows its progress.
inspect.lost: The process is gone and never reported its exit (the UI server was probably restarted). Its artifacts, if any, are kept.
inspect.blocked: The site blocked the inspection (anti-bot, CAPTCHA or login). EXEGEZIS does not try to get past that block.
inspect.engineError: The browser could not start on this computer. The problem is on this computer, not on the site: no conclusion was drawn about it.
inspect.terminal: The same inspection from a terminal:

investigation.running: The CLI is running. This page follows its output and links the investigation as soon as its artifacts exist.
investigation.lost: The process is gone and never reported an exit code (the UI server was probably restarted). Its artifacts, if any, are kept.
investigation.noBrowser: No browser could start (exit code 7): no conclusion was drawn about the application. The detail is in the CLI output.
